pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: big 2-story hip, E-W ridge near y 504 from x 526 to 599 (LiDAR 35 ft, eave about 14 ft); N face is one 7.9/12 plane of about 900 sq ft from the ridge to the north eave at y 355 (x 533-675); the navy patch (535-600,355-440) is that N face in the NW wing cast shadow, not ground; W face from x 425 is the same plane as the NW wing W face; hips to the SW corner (420,606) and SE corner (675,617); small chamfer at the NE corner near (650-675,355-375)

pieces.name: nw_wing
pieces.notes: 2-story N-S hip wing on the NW, dark N-facing triangle at the north eave (hips (438,298) and (520,298) meeting at (477,354)), ridge at x about 475 south to y 419 where it dies into the main; its E face meets the main N face in the valley from (528,377) to (480,435)

pieces.name: w_shed
pieces.notes: 1-story lean-to on the NW wing west wall, high edge along x 425, sloping west (LiDAR: 107 pts, 9.1/12 W-facing, centre 14 ft, tight fit). Doubt: the white objects on it at (380-408,305-350) look like patio furniture, so this could be a deck or a ground patio; if the LiDAR fill looks wrong here, exclude it instead

pieces.name: s_gable
pieces.notes: N-S gable cross wing on the main south slope: ridge at x about 550 from the main ridge down to the south eave at full height (LiDAR 32 ft at (552,621)), steep 10/12 W and E faces; shows as a darker triangle with apex (540,522) and base (490-600,615), its sides are valleys into the main S face, not hips

notes: 2-story hip main with an E-W ridge, a N-S hip wing on the NW, a south-pointing gable on the S slope, and a 1-story west lean-to. Trace matches the eaves closely; no exclusions needed. Confidence med-high on main, NW wing and S gable (LiDAR lines and image agree); low on the west lean-to (sloped per LiDAR but objects on it look like furniture).
